outputs.explanation: This is a scatter plot in which each of the n=141 samples is plotted as an individual point; the marginal histograms simply show the distribution of these same individual data points. Scatter plots are exempt from requiring additional overlay of individual points.
This is a scatter plot (with error bars showing mean ± s.d. across replicates for each sample/cell line). Scatter plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
These are smoothed density/distribution curves (line plots) of subtype-averaged periods and amplitudes. Line/density plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
This is a box plot, which is exempt from the requirement by default, and it additionally already displays individual sample data points overlaid on the boxes.
These are polar histograms showing the distribution of phase differences per cell line; as histograms/distribution plots they are exempt from requiring separate overlay of individual points.
This is a polar histogram summarizing phase-difference distributions averaged by subtype; as a histogram/distribution-type plot it is exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

This panel shows a single example signal trace with a fitted decaying sinusoidal model (a line plot/schematic illustration of the fitting method), not an averaged summary statistic requiring individual data points.

This is a scatter plot where each of the n=117 samples is shown as an individual point (with error bars reflecting fitting uncertainty, not replicate averaging). Scatter plots are exempt from requiring additional overlaid individual points.
